constraints: Target must resolve to exactly one editable visible unlocked native Image with rasterState.colorRaster. ReferenceImage and src-only images are rejected.
Image stack params are structurally bounded to 8 KiB, depth 4, 64 object keys, array length 128, finite numbers and 512-character strings.

Non-source one-shot local retouch only: Dodge/Burn/Sponge/Local Blur/Local Sharpen/Color Replacement. Uses existing raster-retouch algorithms, native rasterState and pixel/mask stale fingerprints. Clone/Healing/Patch/Pattern Stamp remain separate source-contract work.
result.description: Operation-specific bounded edit descriptor for image.raster.localRetouch.v1.

arguments.description: One-shot raster-local retouch. Tool-specific parameters are validated by the bounded edit normalizer; raw masks, pointer strokes and source-point inference are not accepted.

referenceColor.description: Optional Color Replacement reference color; defaults to center pixel.

replacementColor.description: Color Replacement target hue/saturation as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Required when type=colorReplacement.

type.description: Qualified non-source local retouch family. Spot Healing is a separate operation; Clone/Healing/Patch/Pattern Stamp are excluded.

paperFingerprint.description: Expected active-page paper fingerprint; captured automatically for page.paper.set.v1.

revisionId.description: Expected revision id; omit when not constraining revision.

operation.description: Apply one bounded non-source local destructive retouch edit to an editable native 8-bit RGB raster through existing raster-retouch algorithms.
